content: संवारः .²1 Covering, closing up. .²2 Contraction of the throat <ab>&c.</ab> in the pronunciation of letters, obtuse articulation (<ab>opp.</ab> विवार <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²3 Diminution. .²4 Protecting, securing. .²5 Arranging. .²6 An obstacle, impediment; प्रत्यग्रापनीतसंयमनस्य भवतोऽलघुसंवारा गतिः <ls>Mk. 7. 6</ls>, <ls n="Mk. 7.">7</ls>.
